allClearSub: No results outside the usual range.
uploadSub: Photos, scans or PDFs. Handwritten and bilingual are fine.
limits: JPG, PNG or PDF · up to 15 MB each
tip1: Use good, even light and avoid shadows
tip2: Lay the page flat with all four corners in view
tip3: One clear photo per page, or upload the PDF
tooBig: File is too large (15 MB max)
badType: Only JPG, PNG or PDF files
failedSub: Try a clearer, well-lit photo or the original PDF.
busySub: Something stopped us partway, such as a busy service or a server restart. Tap Rescan to try again.
noData: Nothing was extracted from this document.
timelineSub: Everything in one place, newest first.
noItemsSub: Upload a document to start your timeline.
abhaSub: Link your ABHA, pull records from facilities, and export everything as FHIR.
importSub: Pull the latest records from your linked hospitals and labs.
exportSub: A standards-based copy of all your records.
mockNote: Demo only: real ABDM integration needs sandbox registration.
disclaimer: This app helps you understand your records. It does not provide diagnosis or treatment. Always consult a qualified doctor.

details.title: Your details

serverWakingSub: This can take up to a minute after a quiet spell. We'll keep trying.

intro.title: Your medical records, in words you understand.
intro.alt: Example: a photographed lab report is read, a low haemoglobin value is flagged, and it is explained in plain words.
intro.explain: Haemoglobin is a little below the usual range. It carries oxygen in your blood, so a low value can leave you feeling tired. Ask your doctor what may be causing it.
